rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for correcting a loose description with a precise fact.

example.english: Technically, fish ball noodles do not count as soup noodles.
example.traditional: 嚴格嚟講，魚蛋粉唔算係湯麵。
example.jyutping: jim4 gaak3 lai4 gong2 jyu4 daan2 fan2 m4 syun3 hai6 tong1 min6

rows.note: Use this for someone's technical skill or technique rather than the strictly factual sense.

example.english: Technically, they are really good at playing the guitar.
example.traditional: 技術上，佢彈結他真係好掂。
example.jyutping: gei6 seot6 soeng6 keoi5 daan6 git6 taa1 zan1 hai6 hou2 dim6

rows.jyutping: zau6 ji4 gaa1 ge3 gei6 seot6 lai4 gong2
rows.note: Use this when feasibility depends on the technology currently available.

example.english: Technically, the machine still cannot translate in real time.
example.traditional: 就而家嘅技術嚟講，部機仲未可以做到即時翻譯。
example.jyutping: zau6 ji4 gaa1 ge3 gei6 seot6 lai4 gong2 bou6 gei1 zung6 mei6 ho2 ji5 zou6 dou3 zik1 si4 faan1 jik6
